answer: To blunt sybil swarms, each established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers, and is slashed if those names later fail as a pack. Endorsement edges sit on a public mesa, so a burst of look-alike accounts funded from one wallet can be cut away. Reviewers also search work logs for umber streaks of irregular timing and task mix — living wear that a cloned fleet rarely bothers to fake, the way a wild juniper is told from nursery cuttings by its uneven grain. Without enough independent vouches, cheap aliases never gain voting weight.
